verdict.rationale: Cognee publishes a pricing page that offers a free option: the open-source engine can be run locally or self-hosted "free, forever", and the docs confirm the UI and pipelines run locally for free with no account. The pack shows no per-unit rates, Cloud plan prices, or usage metering on that page, so the core goal of projecting memory costs is unsupported. Missing for 10: per-unit or usage-based rates, Cloud tier prices, a hosted free-tier allowance with limits, and independent corroboration of pricing.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published pricing with a free tier and per-unit rates so I can project memory costs before committing

citations.quote: Cognee is open source. Run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever.
you can also run the UI and all pipelines entirely on your own machine for free, with no account required, using `cognee.start_ui()`
